tagline: Storage · the price after the promo

renter_quotes.text: The first month was a dollar. By month five my rent had gone up by about a third, and the notice was easy to miss.
Nobody mentioned the admin fee or the required insurance until I was at the counter with a truck outside.
I compared promos, not the rate after the promo. That was the mistake.
New customers were being offered less for the same size unit I'd been paying more for after two increases.
Asking for the rate-increase policy in writing was the most useful thing I did before signing.
The quote looked cheap until I added the lock, the fee and the protection plan — then it was the priciest of the three.
